result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on which ecommerce platform you're using. If you're selling in Canada, there are a few additional things worth considering.

Here's how I'd rank the options.

## Best payment processors for small businesses

![Für Hello Kitty Fans - Mibrix](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tOiZ9v22mWkKDkODjZ-v8UmHuYEacS351-fhJlicedtzRtyvIPyT0LbHRVsov1FwCqimbt2M5XbGmMjfcFRqoBnSC867jR1vj2Q9kN8GWqWxrNowdJCqgKFlsNcxOvUQZiEoQ3wUV3e9Iv-ULg-8O_uiwrVTYdmAuanbvrKZ5q48tOAeoqXUh_tpwPm1cZkj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Supports credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.
- Excellent reporting and fraud prevention.

Best for: Independent online stores, WooCommerce and custom websites.

[Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple refunds and order reconciliation.
- Supports digital wallets and Shop Pay.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

Best for: Anyone already running a Shopify store.

[Shopify Payments Canada](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognizable and trusted by many shoppers.
- Offers PayPal checkout and card payments.
- Easy to add to many online stores.

Best for: An additional checkout option alongside Stripe or Shopify Payments.

[PayPal Business Canada](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Combines online and in-person payments.
- Easy setup and inventory tools.
- Good for businesses with physical sales too.

Best for: Small retailers selling online and in person.

[Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Canadian payment processor.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- Worth considering as your transaction volume grows.

Best for: Businesses wanting to optimize processing costs.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com/)

These comparisons are consistent with current ecommerce platform recommendations. ## My recommendation

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Growing Canadian business | Compare Helcim |
| Want another checkout option | Add PayPal |
